rationale: Watch-only: the change makes the differential lab compare the native import in Chromium page space (rigid observer placement, snapshot-resolved page canvas, single geometry registration), binds observer work counters and a teardown readback into the render receipt, gates promotion on them, adds an IR-bound retained/rebuild benchmark lane, and places captured text baselines the way Chromium's run rect does. Production native promotion stays disabled; Chromium remains the oracle; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'fill_text places the alphabetic baseline at y'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'Label honors Chromium captured vertical line positions'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'native codegen preserves the browser'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'lifetime counters advance once per view'
